# SYNTHETIC TEST DATA / NOT OFFICIAL COMPETITION DATA

Every file under this directory is generated by `tests/build_fixtures.py`.
It exists only to exercise the loader, validator, catalog and mock
environment on CPU with stdlib-only dependencies. Shapes are *plausible
guesses*, not the organizer's schema. Do not report numbers from this
data as results.

No `*_environment` directory exists here on purpose: the mock environment
is seeded from `mock_state/<id>.json`.
